name: C4 Component Diagram (Level 3)
description: C4 Component Diagram (Level 3) breaks down the internal structure of a container into components: controller, service, repository, client. Each component is a code module inside the container.
purpose: Describe in detail the components inside a container and their relationships.
bestFor: Describe dependencies between controller, service, repository
Define interfaces and responsibilities of each component
Serve as a basis for implementing code
notSuitableFor: Describe container overview → go back to Level 2 (Container)
Describe class entity in detail → go to Level 4 (Code)
Describe deployment infrastructure → use Deployment Diagram
useCases: Identify internal components: Controller, Service, Repository
Identify provided and required component interfaces
Draw dependencies between components and external
requirements: Components — code modules inside the container

elements.name: Component
elements.description: Code module: Controller, Service, Repository, Client

elements.name: Interface
elements.description: API the component provides or requires to operate

confusableWith.difference: C4 Component at module/service level; Class Diagram at class entity level.
C4 Component focuses on component code; Composite Structure focuses on runtime parts and connectors.
